item.title: Cameron earns Master of Science in Nursing
item.description: Congratulations to Sierra Cameron on earning her Master of Science in Nursing from Rockhurst University and achieving her nurse practitioner credential!Sierra is part of the Bates County Memorial Surgery Department and will soon be taking the next step in her nursing career. We’re proud of her accomplishment and wish her continued success in the journey ahead.Courtesy BCMH

item.title: Santa makes special visit to Butler Public Library
item.description: You'd think with worldwide Christmas deliveries ahead, Santa would be way too busy- however, he made a very special visit to the Butler Public Library last week taking the time to read to a group of very appreciative youngsters which yes, contend they all have been good this year.

item.title: Eagles play well in Sedalia
item.description: Miami 8th grade students (Jared Fuqua, Tyler Hragyil, and Jaed Roark) attended WCMMEA JH District Honor Band on Sat. in Sedalia. Rehearsal began at 8:30 am and was followed by a concert at 4. The group of about 116 students was directed by Mr. Justin Doss. It was a long day, but a fun one!

item.title: Obituary - Edna Roller
item.description: Edna Mae (McBride) Roller, 89, of Garden City, Missouri, passed away at her home under hospice care on Monday, December 15, 2025. A visitation will be held on Thursday, December 18, 2025, from 12:00 to 1:00 PM at Atkinson Funeral Home in Harrisonville, MO. Graveside services will follow at 1:30 PM at Garden City Cemetery in Garden City, MO. item.title: BCMH food drive a success
item.description: Our food drive is now wrapped up, led by BCMH Family Care Clinics provider Dr. Miller and general surgeon Dr. Joyce. The non-perishable items pictured represent a little more than half of the donations collected for local organizations supporting food security, including the Carpenter’s Cup and the Community Food Pantry. item.title: Bates County Industries Staff Spotlight
item.description: Staff spotlight!Michaela joined our team in May as the Program Director. She oversees all programming at BCI including safety, production, vocational training, and skill building classes. She is well organized and keeps everyone in the know and everything running smoothly. We enjoy her sweet nature and get it done mentality. In her free time she enjoys hanging out with her friends and family, spending time outside, and chasing around her toddler. Thank you for all that you do, Michaela!Courtesy
